recommendations.name: PagerDuty Pre-Commit Risk Score
recommendations.description: A Claude Code plugin whose /risk-score command checks your uncommitted changes against about 90 days of PagerDuty incident history and returns a 0-5 score with recommendations, but it needs a PagerDuty API key.

recommendations.name: pr-impact
recommendations.description: A community plugin with a /pr-impact command that scores your branch 0-100 from six factors (breaking changes, untested code, diff size, stale docs, config changes, impact breadth) and also ships a GitHub Action; I could not fetch its page, so this comes from the search snippet only.

recommendations.name: PR Risk Scorer (/score-pr slash command)
recommendations.description: A drop-in /score-pr command you copy into .claude/commands/ that scores your latest commit on diff size, complexity, coverage gap, dead code and migrations and gives a LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH tier, though its signals are Python-oriented (radon, vulture, coverage.xml).
